screens.name: approach
screens.evidence: Sheet 01 shows consistent entrance and settled compositions; supplied runtime evidence reports automatic advancement and immediate advancement with reduced motion.
findings: Clarify the passive transition through the supporting line, since “Come closer” can sound like an instruction requiring action.

screens.name: ask
screens.evidence: Sheet 02 shows stable transition and settled question forms, while runtime evidence reports working submission and typing fallback.
findings: Label the person-mode action “Switch to asking about someone” so it cannot be mistaken for the current form heading.

screens.name: ask-large
screens.evidence: Sheet 01 shows enlarged question text filling most of the form and a partially visible primary action; reported layout checks establish scrolling rather than action inaccessibility.
findings: Reduce discretionary vertical spacing at 200% so the submission action is easier to discover after entering a question.

screens.name: ask-person
screens.evidence: Sheet 02 shows the named-person form and consistent transition pair; supplied runtime evidence reports person validation and a real teen named-person reading.
findings: Replace the heading-like “Ask about myself” action with an explicit switch label and give the name field a direct “Their first name” label.

screens.name: ask-person-200pct
screens.evidence: Sheet 01 shows doubled name and question text with later content below the viewport; runtime evidence reports exact input scaling and passing scrollable layouts.
findings: Keep the person identity, question and submit action closer together at enlarged text sizes.

screens.name: card-1
screens.evidence: Sheet 03 shows a stable first-card pair with four separated answers; runtime evidence reports single keyboard advancement, question focus and Back preservation.
findings: Make immediate advancement discoverable before the first answer so users know a choice also continues.

screens.name: card-2
screens.evidence: Sheet 03 preserves the first card’s layout and clearly changes progress to 2 of 3, with shared keyboard behavior reported.
findings: Retain the stable question and answer positions when adaptive questions have substantially different lengths.

screens.name: card-3
screens.evidence: Sheet 04 shows the final synthetic stress card with legible progress and consistent transition geometry.
findings: Distinguish the final answer’s forecast-generation consequence from ordinary advancement.

screens.name: card-other
screens.evidence: Sheets 04–05 show persistent question context, Choices and an empty multiline field; runtime evidence reports answer retention and focus restoration.
findings: Use “Back to choices” and a direct field label to make the compact alternate-input layout self-explanatory.

screens.name: card-other-large
screens.evidence: Sheet 04 keeps the enlarged question, input and disabled Continue visible; supplied evidence also reports a successful keyboard-constrained browser viewport check.
findings: Explain that an answer enables Continue instead of communicating the requirement only through button dimming.

screens.name: check-in
screens.evidence: Sheet 05 shows stable check-in compositions with outcome choices above a more visually prominent Share button.
findings: Give the outcome question and its choices more emphasis than sharing during a check-in.

screens.name: circles-offline
screens.evidence: Sheet 05 explicitly shows offline status, Retry, disabled creation and an unavailable sharing preference; runtime evidence reports offline creation checks.
findings: Place the offline explanation beside the disabled creation action so the reason remains clear while scanning.

screens.name: error-plan
screens.evidence: Sheet 06 shows stable error recovery with Try again, Edit question and no-charge reassurance; runtime evidence reports connection recovery without spending credit.
findings: Preserve this clear recovery hierarchy when displaying non-fixture error messages.

screens.name: error-predict
screens.evidence: Sheet 06 adds Review answers to the prediction failure state while retaining the same prominent retry action.
findings: Keep Review answers secondary to retry and preserve the completed answers throughout recovery.

screens.name: history-empty
screens.evidence: Sheet 08 shows a stable empty state, device-storage explanation and a direct Ask the Ball action.
findings: Maintain the direct creation action and storage explanation as the history empty-state contract.

screens.name: history-filled
screens.evidence: Sheet 07 shows consistent populated transition pairs with a question, forecast, date column and check-back date.
findings: Render check-back dates in a readable local format rather than raw YYYY-MM-DD.

screens.name: history-stress
screens.evidence: Sheet 07 shows several separated history rows with additional content continuing above the fixed navigation.
findings: Use a consistent compact date format to make longer histories easier to scan.

screens.name: history-outcome-persisted
screens.evidence: Sheet 07 replaces the first row’s pending date with a checked Came true status, and runtime evidence reports persisted outcomes.
findings: Keep the explicit outcome text and checkmark together so saved status is not conveyed by gold alone.

screens.name: home
screens.evidence: Sheets 08–09 show the dominant gold orb, touch instruction and no-omen state; reported browser checks cover overlap, scaling and reduced motion.
findings: Give the rotating sample question a more consistent visible presence across entrance and settled frames.

screens.name: home-omen-fixture
screens.evidence: Sheet 08 shows the populated omen fixture and a very faint sample question above the hero orb.
findings: Keep the sample-question text legible throughout its displayed phase or omit it until fully visible.

screens.name: listening-unavailable
screens.evidence: Sheet 09 shows Type your question as primary, Try voice again and a persistent microphone failure notice; runtime evidence reports typing fallback.
findings: Bring the microphone explanation closer to the fallback controls to reduce the distance between problem and recovery.

screens.name: onboarding-age
screens.evidence: Sheet 10 clearly presents both age responses with stable transition geometry; runtime evidence reports persisted eligibility and under-13 reload gating.
findings: Retain equally explicit wording for both age responses throughout the eligibility flow.

screens.name: onboarding-age-200pct
screens.evidence: Sheet 09 shows the enlarged age question and both response controls fitting comfortably within the viewport.
findings: Preserve this complete question-and-response grouping at the narrowest enlarged-text width.

screens.name: onboarding-birthday
screens.evidence: Sheets 10–11 show optional birthday entry, format guidance and Skip for now; runtime evidence reports invalid and valid onboarding.
findings: Explain why a full birth year is requested when the nearby benefit describes only calculating a Sun sign.

screens.name: onboarding-birthday-200pct
screens.evidence: Sheet 10 shows an enlarged birthday field with Continue and Skip for now visible, supported by reported exact field scaling.
findings: Shorten the enlarged heading’s vertical footprint while retaining the full birthday-entry guidance.

screens.name: onboarding-focus
screens.evidence: Sheet 11 shows four focus options and three onward/back actions beneath a repeated birthday explanation.
findings: Replace the birthday explanation with selection guidance and clarify whether choosing a focus is optional.

screens.name: onboarding-focus-200pct
screens.evidence: Sheet 11 shows the enlarged title and unrelated birthday explanation pushing onward actions below the viewport; scrolling is supported by supplied layout evidence.
findings: Remove the repeated birthday copy and reduce excess spacing so enlarged focus selection reaches its continuation sooner.

screens.name: outcome-no-saved
screens.evidence: Sheet 12 shows a checked Not quite choice, inline Saved status and a Saved to your history notice.
findings: Reduce duplicate confirmation prominence while retaining the persistent inline saved outcome.

screens.name: outcome-pending-saved
screens.evidence: Sheet 12 distinguishes Not yet with a checkmark, saved pending status and a waiting confirmation.
findings: Keep the persistent pending status visible after the temporary confirmation is dismissed.

screens.name: outcome-yes-saved
screens.evidence: Sheet 12 shows the checked Yes choice, Saved Came true text and an explicit history confirmation.
findings: Use the inline outcome as the lasting confirmation and keep the additional notice visually subordinate.

screens.name: paywall
screens.evidence: Sheet 13 shows explicit test mode, annual selection, prices, a primary simulated subscription action and reading packs; runtime evidence reports simulated plans and Restore.
findings: Make the annual billing total and renewal commitment at least as easy to scan as the monthly equivalent.

screens.name: paywall-large
screens.evidence: Sheet 12 preserves enlarged plan prices and annual selection but shows only part of the primary action within the viewport.
findings: Tighten plan spacing at 200% so the selected commitment and full continuation label can be reviewed together more easily.

screens.name: planning
screens.evidence: Sheet 13 shows stable loading compositions with a phase explanation, wait estimate, credit reassurance and Cancel; supplied evidence reports reduced-motion handling.
findings: Provide an updated status if the stated minute is exceeded so the same loading message does not become ambiguous.

screens.name: research
screens.evidence: Sheet 14 identifies contextual research separately from planning while maintaining the orb, estimate and cancellation layout.
findings: Make phase progression explicit enough that two consecutive mist-gathering screens do not feel like a stalled request.

screens.name: reveal
screens.evidence: Sheets 15–16 show a stable forecast hierarchy, speculative label, date, explanation and several follow-up actions; runtime evidence reports a real dated local-model forecast.
findings: Group editing and answer-review actions under a secondary disclosure to give the forecast and its explanation more breathing room.

screens.name: reveal-why
screens.evidence: Sheet 15 shows preserved long stress content under a clear forecast context; supplied evidence reports disclosure keyboard operation and focus return.
findings: Break context and assumptions into distinct visual sections so long explanations remain scannable without discarding fixture content.

screens.name: reveal-evidence
screens.evidence: Sheets 14–15 show expanded context, assumptions and sources with long synthetic content retained, and supplied evidence reports passing disclosure and contrast checks.
findings: Give each source a compact identifiable heading before its long title so expanded evidence can be scanned efficiently.

screens.name: reveal-evidence-200pct
screens.evidence: Sheet 14 shows enlarged evidence continuing across the viewport, with persistent Close and balance controls; supplied evidence reports preserved full content and heading focus.
findings: Add stronger section orientation for long enlarged evidence so users can identify their position while scrolling.

screens.name: sensitive-plan
screens.evidence: Sheet 16 shows a distinct support redirect, alternate question actions and explicit no-credit/no-memory reassurance; runtime evidence reports a real sensitive redirect.
findings: Specify the destination or kind of help behind “Find support near you” before users leave the app.

screens.name: sensitive-predict
screens.evidence: Sheets 16–17 retain the same support hierarchy during the prediction phase without presenting a forecast as successful.
findings: Use the same explicit destination description for support links in both sensitive-flow stages.

screens.name: settings-controls
screens.evidence: Sheet 17 shows full preference rows and account actions with a section heading partly passing under the fixed header; runtime evidence reports keyboard operation, focus and persistence.
findings: Make section boundaries clearer at the sticky-header edge so clipped headings do not appear attached to unrelated controls.

screens.name: settings-controls-large
screens.evidence: Sheet 17 shows doubled preference labels and selected Large text while later content continues behind the viewport edge; supplied evidence reports navigation clearance.
findings: Preserve a clear visual gap between the last visible settings row and fixed navigation during enlarged scrolling.

screens.name: share
screens.evidence: Sheets 18–19 show stable preview, Download image, privacy statement and collapsed optional actions; runtime evidence reports real PNG export and failure recovery.
findings: Offer a more readable preview inspection affordance so users can verify the artifact’s small disclaimer before downloading.

screens.name: share-200pct
screens.evidence: Sheet 17 enlarges the heading and download action while retaining a small fixed-artwork preview and pushing privacy text below the fold.
findings: Expose an accessible text equivalent or enlarged inspection of the preview without requiring users to read miniature artwork.

screens.name: share-options
screens.evidence: Sheet 18 shows expanded invitation and reminder actions with explicit invitation privacy text and consistent transition geometry.
findings: Keep the reminder’s external-delivery expectation as explicit as the invitation’s privacy explanation.

screens.name: share-options-200pct
screens.evidence: Sheet 18 shows enlarged privacy and invitation content continuing below the viewport, supported by reported large-text layout checks.
findings: Reduce nonessential vertical gaps so both expanded optional actions are easier to discover at 200%.

screens.name: sky-offline-sample
screens.evidence: Sheet 19 clearly labels sample stars and offline status, marks Love as selected and presents a matching question with a primary action.
findings: Strengthen the visual connection between the selected star and its question without relying primarily on gold.

screens.name: story
screens.evidence: Sheets 19–20 show a larger portrait artifact with forecast, speculative disclaimer and Download image; runtime evidence reports a real 1080×1920 PNG.
findings: Increase the artifact’s smallest disclaimer and tagline sizes to remain readable when the image is viewed in a social feed.

screens.name: you
screens.evidence: Sheets 21–22 show stable profile, plan and empty-memory sections with explicit editing and forgetting language.
findings: Use consistent display capitalization and human-readable birthday formatting in the profile summary.

screens.name: you-birthday
screens.evidence: Sheet 21 shows the open birthday editor, primary Save birthday, Forget birthday and surrounding profile context.
findings: Give the editable date an explicit visible label and distinguish closing the editor from saving changes.

screens.name: you-birthday-200pct
screens.evidence: Sheet 21 preserves the enlarged editable date and Save birthday action above navigation, with exact field scaling reported.
findings: Keep the input label and save/close distinction explicit when enlarged text separates the editor from its surrounding summary.

screens.name: you-birth-details
screens.evidence: Sheet 20 shows optional local birth time, city lookup and disabled reveal; runtime evidence reports live Copenhagen geocoding and calculated Moon/rising results.
findings: Explain that selecting a city enables the final action and make the required time accuracy clear.

screens.name: you-birth-details-200pct
screens.evidence: Sheet 20 shows profile summary and editor controls consuming the enlarged viewport before the birth-detail inputs appear, while supplied checks report scrollable layouts.
findings: Collapse redundant profile-summary content while editing birth details to bring the actual fields into view sooner.

components.name: hero orb
components.evidence: Home uses a dominant illustrated gold orb while task screens use smaller mist orbs; supplied evidence reports smooth browser rendering and stopped draws under reduced motion.
findings: Keep the Home orb’s activation instruction closely associated with it so decorative and interactive orb roles remain distinguishable.

components.name: tab bar
components.evidence: Sheets show five consistently labeled destinations, an elevated Ask orb and gold/underline selection, with enlarged-label clearance reported.
findings: Verify and retain generous full-item targets around the visually small non-Ask icons.

components.name: wordmark and balance header
components.evidence: The script wordmark or screen title consistently pairs with a quiet reading balance, and reveal changes the displayed balance to zero.
findings: Clarify whether the underlined balance is actionable so it does not resemble an unexplained input or link.

components.name: primary button
components.evidence: Cream pill buttons consistently identify the primary action, with supplied runtime evidence covering disabled export, retry and keyboard interaction.
findings: Retain full multiline labels and nearby prerequisite explanations whenever the primary action is disabled.

components.name: secondary action
components.evidence: Gold text links, centered white rows and underlined row boundaries represent secondary actions across the sheets.
findings: Standardize secondary-action presentation and use explicit verbs for mode switches and disclosure navigation.

components.name: answer choice
components.evidence: Cards present spacious separated choices, and supplied runtime evidence reports Space/Enter activation, single advancement and preserved answers on Back.
findings: Signal that choosing an answer immediately continues, particularly before the first and final choices.

components.name: question input
components.evidence: Ask forms show prominent serif multiline text inside a gold outline with an additional bottom rule and explicit field labeling.
findings: Simplify the double-border treatment while preserving a clearly distinguishable keyboard focus state.

components.name: large-text input
components.evidence: Enlarged question and custom-answer fields wrap text without visible horizontal overflow; supplied evidence reports doubled field sizes and retained long answers.
findings: Reduce surrounding decorative space so enlarged fields do not unnecessarily separate users from submission controls.

components.name: settings switch
components.evidence: Sheet 17 shows aligned switches with distinct thumb positions and selected gold, while supplied evidence reports full-row labels, keyboard operation, focus and persistence.
findings: Preserve full-row activation and visible focus when preference labels wrap at enlarged sizes.

components.name: omen content
components.evidence: Home shows both a populated synthetic omen and a clear no-omen fallback with an alternate action.
findings: Keep populated and empty omen blocks similar in height to preserve Home’s composition across daily states.

components.name: sky stars and selected question
components.evidence: Sheet 19 links a checked Love star to a sample question and Ask this too, but component-specific target dimensions are not supplied.
findings: Ensure each star and label form one generous target with an explicit selected state beyond color.

components.name: circle surface
components.evidence: The offline Circles surface explains sharing scope, disables creation and presents Retry, with offline behavior reported.
findings: Associate disabled creation directly with the offline reason instead of leaving users to connect separated messages.

components.name: history row
components.evidence: Sheet 07 separates dates, original questions, forecasts and persisted outcomes with consistent quiet dividers.
findings: Use readable localized check-back dates and preserve a clear accessible name for opening each reading.

components.name: plan option
components.evidence: Paywall options show annual selection with a checkmark, total price, monthly equivalent and a visibly separate monthly plan.
findings: Keep billing frequency and total commitment together at normal and enlarged text sizes.

components.name: share preview
components.evidence: Share screens retain a small portrait artwork with miniature disclaimer text even when surrounding interface text doubles.
findings: Provide a readable text equivalent and obvious enlarged preview access for the artwork’s forecast and disclaimer.

components.name: notice and recovery
components.evidence: Voice failure and saved outcomes use persistent dark notices with Dismiss, while reading failures expose explicit retry paths.
findings: Keep notices close to their affected task and avoid repeating the same confirmation at equal prominence.

components.name: typography system
components.evidence: Display serif, restrained script and sans-serif utility text have consistent roles, with reported sampled contrast and genuine 200% scaling.
findings: Reserve ornate oversized text for short statements and strengthen long-form evidence scanning.

components.name: atmospheric background
components.evidence: Dark mist and restrained gold illumination remain coherent across sheets, with supplied browser evidence reporting sampled contrast, reduced motion and isolated smooth rendering.
findings: Keep text-bearing areas visually quiet as mist changes across animated frames.

components.name: birthday input
components.evidence: Onboarding labels the required date format, whereas the profile editor presents the date without an adjacent explicit field label; runtime evidence reports validation and scaling.
findings: Use a persistent Birthday label and consistent format guidance in both input locations.

components.name: age confirmation
components.evidence: Normal and enlarged age screens expose both explicit responses, with supplied runtime evidence covering persisted decline and reload gating.
findings: Retain both unambiguous age choices and the concise no-birthday reassurance.

components.name: focus selection
components.evidence: Sheet 11 shows four focus rows with no visibly selected example and unrelated birthday guidance above them.
findings: Replace the unrelated guidance with the selection rule and demonstrate a clearly marked selected option.

components.name: birth-profile surface
components.evidence: Sheets 20–22 show Sun sign, age range, birthday and editing controls consistently across closed and open profile states.
findings: Use human-readable birthday formatting and consistent Sun-sign capitalization in summaries.

components.name: birth-details form
components.evidence: The form exposes local time, city lookup and disabled reveal, with supplied runtime evidence covering live geocoding and a calculated result.
findings: Explain the missing prerequisite beside each disabled action and reduce redundant summary content above the form.

components.name: named-person control
components.evidence: Sheets 01–02 show first-name entry and privacy guidance under a switch action that visually resembles a current-mode heading.
findings: Separate the current person-mode heading from an explicit switch action and label the field “Their first name.”

components.name: evidence disclosure
components.evidence: Expanded sections retain long fixture facts, assumptions and source titles; supplied evidence reports Enter operation and correct focus entry/return.
findings: Add concise section summaries and stronger source-title structure without truncating underlying evidence.

components.name: export status
components.evidence: Supplied runtime evidence reports Preparing image, synchronous double-activation prevention, independent Invite availability, injected failure recovery and a real PNG download.
findings: Capture the preparing and failed-export states visually and verify that their status changes are announced accessibly.

limitations: Scores are provisional browser judgments based on the attached sheets and supplied runtime account; no files, source, previous graders or other rounds were inspected.
The authorized A>=9 and F>=9 threshold is not met across all screens and components; strong visual coherence does not erase the specific clarity and accessibility weaknesses.

A is the mean of hierarchy, typography and surfaces; F is the mean of clarity, feedback and accessibility; overall is 0.4A+0.6F rounded to one decimal, excluding genuinely inapplicable null dimensions.
No hard-gate failure is established by this evidence: content below the viewport is not proof of an unreachable action, especially given the reported passing scroll checks.

Transition pairs support compositional continuity but cannot independently establish continuous motion, input timing or every intermediate frame; performance and reduced-motion findings rely on the supplied runtime account.
Runtime checks were not independently replayed; reported axe and sampled contrast passes do not prove complete accessibility, every target size or live status announcements.
Enlarged variants are scored separately where pictured; missing enlarged screenshots for other states remain supported only by the supplied layout-sweep account.
Physical iPhone Safari, native Dynamic Type, VoiceOver, hardware keyboard, microphone and haptics remain unverified; these scores do not certify full/native 9 or 10.
Payments are simulated, social services are offline or unconfigured, and browser PNG download does not establish OS sharing, invitation or reminder delivery.
Synthetic wording, repeated stress content and the three-card sequence establish layout coverage only; they are not production-copy defects or evidence of predictive accuracy.

Export loading/error screenshots, selected focus, invalid field states, populated memory editing and successful birth-result surfaces are not pictured; related claims remain limited to the supplied runtime descriptions.
No modal is separately graded because the sheets do not establish a distinct modal component or its focus-trapping behavior.
topFixes: Make person-mode switching explicit and add an unambiguous first-name field label.
Replace birthday guidance on focus onboarding with selection instructions and a clear selected state.
Provide readable share-artwork text and obvious enlarged preview inspection.
Reduce redundant content and spacing in enlarged forms so primary actions and prerequisites are easier to discover.
Improve long evidence scanning with distinct context, assumption and source structure while preserving all content.
Standardize birthday labels, readable dates and disabled-action explanations.
Capture missing browser selected/loading/error states and verify accessible status announcements before reassessing the threshold.
